title: Deck audience mismatch: handoff/presentation.html is addressed to Dustin Boyd, not investors
description: QA swarm content scan: deck opens 'For Dustin Boyd - the man behind Mockingbird... Design and experience are yours now' and closes 'It is yours now... founding council is Friday, September 18... Bentonville Barber Company'. It is a personal hand-off artifact. Do NOT screen it at the Triton Ventures breakfast as-is; build a separate investor-facing deck (thin shell, live demo, four contracts) or strip the dedication slides.

title: Demo risk: boot-probe debug string in packaged-app window title
description: boot-probe.js always stamps document.title = 'boot:script-loaded tauri=object'; WKWebView shows it in the window title bar of the packaged app. Looks like unfinished instrumentation during an investor demo. Suggested: keep boot:ERROR/boot:REJECTION breadcrumbs (they are the diagnostic value), but on success restore the title to the app name after boot completes. Caution: verify no CI script greps the success title first - boot-probe.js self-describes as temporary.

title: QA swarm: Escape TypeError on inspector drawer before picker first mount
description: Root-caused by QA swarm: main.js Escape handler dereferenced document.getElementById('dir-picker') unguarded, but picker.js lazily mounts #dir-picker on first browse. Fresh session -> open inspector -> Escape threw Uncaught TypeError and closed nothing. FIXED this session (null-guard in main.js) + regression test section 1b in tests/test_desktop_ui.py.

title: Steer/cancel narration is status-bar-only; add persistent transcript marker
description: Swarm finding: 'steer queued - redirecting' and cancel states flash in #status for ~200-500ms only; the transcript renders the steered turn identically to an uninterrupted one, so post-hoc there is no record a redirect happened. For a live audience watching the transcript (not the status bar) the steer moment is invisible. Fix: emit a persistent transcript marker row on steer/cancel. Note: mock stream is ~210ms so this looks worse in QA than live; real streaming makes it visible but still unrecorded.

title: Accessibility polish pack (AA): aria-labels, live region, label-for, tab roles, focus management
description: Swarm a11y sweep: (1) icon-only controls rely on glyph-as-name + title-as-tooltip - add aria-label (sidebar-toggle, sidebar-open, insp-refresh, insp-close, picker up, persona remove, cancel); (2) #status has no aria-live - status transitions silent to AT; (3) settings labels lack for= associations; (4) inspector tabs lack role=tab/aria-selected; (5) no focus handoff/trap on drawer+settings open; (6) #cwd/#prompt use weaker border-only focus than the app's own 2px mint ring; (7) .chip contrast 4.60:1 at 9.5px passes AA by 0.10 - bump size or darken.

title: Narrow-window layout breaks below ~520px
description: Swarm responsive sweep: at 500x700 the topbar .field cannot shrink (cwd field starts at x=-98, browse button pointer-unreachable, #send clipped, page x-scrolls); #sidebar-toggle is click-intercepted by the overflowing browse span; #sidebar-open reappears off-viewport (x=-133) after collapse; the 320px inspector drawer covers 100% of transcript+composer with no scrim. Demo floor is ~800x600 (fine), but half-screen snapping breaks. Fix: min-width:0 on .field, flex-wrap on topbar, collapse media query, drawer width cap.

title: Self-host webfonts: app + deck silently degrade offline
description: Google Fonts (Fraunces, EB Garamond, IM Fell English SC, JetBrains Mono, Inter) load from fonts.googleapis.com at runtime. QA swarm observed the css2 request fail (status 0) and type fall back mid-app; the transcript's display face changes the moment streaming renders. Demo venues have flaky wifi. Fix: vendor the woff2 files + @font-face locally for ui/ and handoff/.

title: Sidebar session-row UX pack: phantom row, stale active highlight, nested destructive x
description: Swarm findings: (1) upsertSession(res.sessionId, cwd, 'new session') runs on every startAcp incl. boot auto-start, so every launch re-stamps a 'new session . now' row the user never created; (2) after New chat the old session keeps the active highlight while you view the new one; (3) the forget-session x button (17x18px, below WCAG 2.5.8 target size) is nested inside the clickable row used to resume - accidental demo-data deletion risk; nested interactive elements are also invalid HTML.

title: Rebuild + verify Core Disc v6 icon set in packaged app
description: Icons committed 73d211e (icns/ico/rasters/iOS/Android on Sevardhet v6). Rebuild the app and verify: new dock icon on macOS, ico on Windows, tiles + Android/iOS sets. Coordinate with active inspector session work.

title: Mock harness gaps: cancel does not stop fake stream; resume emits no replay
description: QA swarm observed cancel as a no-op and resume as a stuck 'Resuming...' placeholder - both are MOCK gaps, not app bugs (real backend sends session/cancel JSON-RPC and session/load replays correctly; cargo tests + acp_probe --lifecycle cover both). Improve tests/test_desktop_ui.py MOCK: grove_acp_cancel should halt the pending fake stream and emit a cancelled/turn-end; resume path should emit a replayed chunk so the UI placeholder is replaced. Then add a UI assertion for cancel feedback.
